title: Our driver arrived to our...
text: Our driver arrived to our cruise port early so we had a stress-free ride to the airport. He was very professional & took care of all our luggage (10 pieces for 5 of us) in the rain.
author: Ellen_B

title: Barcelona Transfers!
text: My experience in Barcelona was fabulous! My family and I had a wonderful time in the city. Viator lessened the stress of traveling as our driver was SUPER timely in the arrival to the BCN Airport to collect my party. The driver was extremely polite and friendly. He helped with loading and off loading our bags into the van. Our van driver dropped us off a short distance from our hotel location where we had to walk down to the main entrance of our hotel. This is only a slight inconvenience as one of the group members has difficulty walking at times. Our second van driver was much the same.. time
